nodes.powitanie.options.[q1_oszczedzony].t: Stach sets nothing. You were wrong.

nodes.powitanie.options.[q1_po].text.t: How's the wood, now it's all over?

nodes.powitanie.options.[q1_wydany].text.t: Stach sets the snares. He told me himself.

nodes.powitanie.text.t: Radowit the gamekeeper sits outside his lodge, cleaning a gun that hasn't smelled powder in years. "What? If it's game you're after, game's scarce as hen's teeth. If it's snares, ask Stach, not me."

nodes.q1_oszczedzony.text.t: The gamekeeper narrows his eyes. "I was wrong? So was the roebuck, when it walked into the snare. But have it your way: you've no proof, I've none, and we're all as clean as after confession. Here's fifteen groats for your trouble. On your head be it."

nodes.q1_po.text.t: "Quiet as a wake. The snares are still hanging, but empty. Stach's stopped setting them, or moved them further off, where I can't see. That's the forest for you: what the eye doesn't see, the heart doesn't grieve over. Good work."

nodes.q1_start.text.t: "Someone's setting snares in the wood, and not for hares. Last night I cut a roebuck out of one, still alive, and I haven't slept since. Stach, most likely, but I never caught him at it, and without proof that's no accusation, just old wives' talk. Talk to him, he's scared of me. Only don't say I sent you."

nodes.q1_wydany.text.t: The gamekeeper slowly puts down his gun. "He told you himself? Either he's a fool, or he wanted you to warn me. I'll deal with him my own way. And here's fifteen groats for your trouble." It's plain that being right gives him no joy at all.
